Chief_Complaint.content: Patient presents with a really bad headache for about one day.
Chief_Complaint.source_text: Patient: Um, I've got a really bad headache, had it for about a day now.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Headache began yesterday morning upon waking.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Patient: Um, yeah, just ever since yesterday morning, since I woke up really.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Headache is mainly located on the left side.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Patient: Uh, mainly on the left side.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Headache has a throbbing quality.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Patient: Um, it just, kind of feels like it's throbbing

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Headache is quite intense.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Patient: it's quite intense

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Headache comes and goes but does not completely resolve.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Patient: Uh, just kind of fades, so it's still there a little bit but, it kind of gets more or less, severe.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports sensitivity to light.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Patient: yeah, quite sensitive to light

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Headache is worse in a light room or sunlight.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Patient: kind of seems to be worse, when I'm in a light room or like sunlight.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient denies eye or eyesight problems.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Doctor: And any, any other symptoms that you've had, any problems with your eyes, or your eyesight? Patient: Uh, no, not at all.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient denies abnormal smells or tastes.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Doctor: Any abnormal smells or tastes? Patient: No.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient denies nausea and vomiting.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Doctor: Any, any nausea, vomiting? Patient: Uh, no, no, been feeling fine actually.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient is eating and drinking well.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Doctor: And have you been eating and drinking OK? Patient: Yeah, yeah, .

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient denies recent cold symptoms prior to onset.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Doctor: Have you had any other symptoms, like feeling feverish, , runny nose, sore ears? Patient: No, not really any sort of, cold symptoms, I seemed OK the day before.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient denies skin changes.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Doctor: Have you had any changes in your skin? Patient: No, skin feeling fine.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has not checked their temperature.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Doctor: Have you checked your temperature at all? Have you got a thermometer at home? Patient: Um, I haven't. Um, I don't feel like I'm feverish, but I haven't checked.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient does not feel feverish.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Patient: Um, I don't feel like I'm feverish, but I haven't checked.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient denies weakness, tingling, or numbness in arms or legs.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Doctor: And any problems with weakness, tingling, numbness in your arms or legs? Patient: No, not at all.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Headache improves when lying down.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Patient: Um, no, think I've generally been lying down, seems to be better that way.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Headache is not worse when lying flat or bending forward.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Doctor: Does it get worse with any position that you're on? Is it worse when you lie flat, or when you bend forward? Patient: Um, no

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Headache is not worsened by coughing or sneezing.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Doctor: Any problems if you cough or sneeze? Patient: Uh, no, but I haven't really got a cough or anything.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Since onset, patient has mainly stayed at home and has not wanted to leave the house much.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Patient: just yeah, kind of throbbing headache, haven't really wanted to leave the house much since then. Patient: Um, taken some painkillers, mainly been at home.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has not typically had headaches in the past.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Doctor: OK. And, normally, do you get any headaches? Patient: Uh, no not really, it's not something I've, ever had before.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Headache is not tied to a particular time in the menstrual cycle.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Doctor: And, has it occurred at a particular term in your menstrual cycle? Patient: Um, no, not particularly

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Last menstrual period was about a week ago.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Patient: my period was about a week ago.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports possible trigger of stress at work.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Patient: not that I can think of, um, may have been a bit stressed out at work, that kind of thing

History_of_Present_Illness.content: At the time of consultation, the headache remains pretty bad and throbbing.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Patient: Um, it's still pretty bad. Um, yeah, still the kind of throbbing, yeah.

Past_Medical_History.content: Patient denies significant past medical problems, hospital admissions, or operations.
Past_Medical_History.source_text: Doctor: ... Have you had any significant medical problems? Any hospital admissions, operations, something like that? Patient: Uh, no, not recently, nothing.

Past_Medical_History.content: Last blood pressure check was about six months ago.
Past_Medical_History.source_text: Doctor: Have you had it checked, when you've had the , repeat prescription done? Patient: Yeah, yeah, so uh, probably about six months ago.

Past_Medical_History.content: Patient reports prior blood pressure readings have been fine.
Past_Medical_History.source_text: Doctor: Do you know if there's been any problems with it? Patient: Um, it's always been fine I think.

Medications.content: Patient uses the Microgynon contraceptive pill.
Microgynon was started approximately six years ago.
Medications.source_text: Doctor: When did you start that one? Patient: Uh, about six years ago.

Medications.content: Patient has taken paracetamol for the headache.
Patient has taken NSAIDs such as ibuprofen or naproxen in the past but not in the last few days.
Medications.source_text: Doctor: ... non-steroidal anti-inflammatories, like Ibuprofen, Naproxen, anything like that? Patient: Um, I have in the past, I haven't been taking it, last few days.

Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.source_text: Patient: Uh, just Paracetamol. Um, I'm allergic to Aspirin, so I haven't been taking that.

Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.content: Aspirin causes the patient to feel really sick (nausea).
Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.source_text: Doctor: What happens when you get a, when you take Aspirin? Patient: Um, I just feel really sick.

Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.content: Patient denies side effects from Microgynon.
Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.source_text: Doctor: Do you get any side effects from it? Patient: Um, not really, um, no, not too much.

Family_History.content: Patient's mother has high blood pressure.
Family_History.source_text: Patient: Uh, my mum had, uh, high blood pressure

Family_History.content: Patient's mother has a history of migraines.
Family_History.source_text: Patient: and she's got a history of migraines.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient lives with housemates who are friends.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: Patient: Uh, just with housemates, um, just friends.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient drinks alcohol, a few drinks at the weekend.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: Doctor: And do you drink much alcohol day-to-day? Patient: Um, I'd say a normal amount, um, probably, you know, a few drinks at the weekend.
Doctor: And do you smoke? Patient: No.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient denies use of other drugs.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: Doctor: Do you take any other drugs of any sort? Patient: No.

Assessment.content: Clinical impression is a migraine-type headache.
Assessment.source_text: Doctor: I mean it, from the sounds of it, it does, sound quite like a migraine

Plan_of_Care.content: Take an anti-inflammatory (e.g., ibuprofen) along with paracetamol.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Doctor: What I would, suggest is, taking, uh, um, some anti-inflammatories, along with the Paracetamol.
Doctor: Make sure you're really well hydrated.

Plan_of_Care.content: Arrange to have blood pressure checked.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Doctor: Um, I would, try and arrange to get your blood pressure checked, if you haven't had it checked for a while.

Plan_of_Care.content: Obtain a thermometer for home temperature monitoring.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Doctor: Uh, and, thing to do is to have a thermometer at home, so you can make sure that your temperature's OK.
Patient: OK, so I'll take some Ibuprofen and I'll um, hopefully, be a bit better in a day or two then, so yeah.

Follow_up_Information.content: Contact the clinic straight away if the headache is getting worse.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: Doctor: If you have a raised temperature or, your headache's just getting worse, or you develop any rashes or anything like that. Then we'd need to speak to you straight away.

Follow_up_Information.content: Contact the clinic straight away if temperature is raised.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: Doctor: If you have a raised temperature or, your headache's just getting worse, or you develop any rashes or anything like that. Then we'd need to speak to you straight away.

Follow_up_Information.content: Contact the clinic straight away if a rash develops.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: Doctor: If you have a raised temperature or, your headache's just getting worse, or you develop any rashes or anything like that. Then we'd need to speak to you straight away.

Follow_up_Information.content: Seek review if there is any other change in the headache.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: Doctor: if it, if it isn't settling, or it's getting worse, or you get any other change in your headache.

Follow_up_Information.content: Arrange further discussion if headaches are persistent, associated with the menstrual cycle, or triggered by certain things.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: Doctor: The other thing is if you, if you're getting persistent, um, headaches, or headaches associated with your menstrual cycle, or certain things seem to trigger these headaches. Then, it, it would be worth, having a further discussion about it
